theMergeActuallyTookThreeAttempts_worthR.why: this repo enforces 'require branches to be up to date before merging'. `gh pr merge` returned GraphQL '5 of 5 required status checks are expected' while mergeStateStatus was BEHIND even though every check was green on the branch tip — a stale-base refusal, not a failed check.
theMergeActuallyTookThreeAttempts_worthR.attempt1: merge refused, mergeStateStatus BEHIND (origin/main had moved with #686/#687)
theMergeActuallyTookThreeAttempts_worthR.attempt2: rebased onto origin/main, force-pushed; Test then FAILED on an unrelated flaky api-server test (canva-route); re-ran the failed job; it went green; but main had moved AGAIN (BEHIND)
theMergeActuallyTookThreeAttempts_worthR.attempt3: `gh pr update-branch 685` (the server-side equivalent of the Update-branch button, no local rebase), waited for Test=SUCCESS with mergeState CLEAN, merged immediately and won the race
theMergeActuallyTookThreeAttempts_worthR.lesson: on this repo, rebase-then-wait loses to a moving main; `gh pr update-branch` followed by an immediate merge is the shape that lands. Also: the '5 of 5 required status checks are expected' string is a stale-base error, never read it as a check failure.
